text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of Mejiro Bright's debut, she shows up at the track carrying a doll. She's as carefree as usual, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, I can tell that she's trying to act her normal self to help remain calm. She's plenty serious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "I'll go at my own pace," she mutters before heading into the paddock.
